name: dacheng-php/yii2-swoole
description: Production-ready Swoole 6 coroutine runtime adapter and async components for Yii2.

suggest.ext-pdo: Required to use yii2swoole\db\Connection pooled database component.
suggest.yiisoft/yii2-debug: Required (^2.1) to use the coroutine-safe Swoole Debug Toolbar and SwoolePanel.
suggest.yiisoft/yii2-httpclient: Required (^2.0) to use coroutine non-blocking HttpClient.
suggest.yiisoft/yii2-queue: Required (^2.3.7) to use coroutine RedisQueue workers.
suggest.yiisoft/yii2-redis: Required (^2.0) to use coroutine Redis connection pool, cache, and default redis\Session.

scripts.lint: php -r 'foreach (new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator("src")) as $f) { if ($f->getExtension() === "php") { passthru("php -l " . escapeshellarg($f->getPathname()), $c); if ($c !== 0) exit($c); } }'
